title: Why iPhones are so expensive in India again
content: Apple's new iPhones cost more this year, not just the Duo, its first foldable, or the 18 Pro. Older models went up too, breaking a five-year run of steady pricing in India. Some of that is tax and currency. Most of it is a global memory shortage, squeezed by AI's appetite for chips. Add India's duty structure and Apple's read on what buyers will pay, and the entry fee for an iPhone has never been higher.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
content: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: Deadly plot by ‘killer bahu’: Kanpur bizman sensed danger, but ended up with 26 stab wounds
content: An alleged murder plot to stage a heart attack was foiled when the victim returned home. The intended suffocation plan changed to a violent stabbing after the victim discovered the attackers. The victim sustained 26 stab wounds during the assault which occurred late at night. The alleged conspirator was reportedly dancing at a lounge while the killing unfolded.

title: 22-year-old pleads guilty in US' biggest Bitcoin theft; spent millions on cars & more
content: A 22-year-old organized a scheme stealing over 4,100 Bitcoin from an investor.  The stolen cryptocurrency was then spent on luxury items and lavish experiences.  Investigators traced the digital trail through a missed IP address, leading to arrests.  Several defendants have pleaded guilty, and others are awaiting sentencing in the ongoing case.  This incident highlights the growing threat of social engineering in cryptocurrency fraud.

title: Meet Daniel Zhang, 17, who built a cancer game now reaching 1,500 children
content: In an innovative step, a San Diego teenager named Daniel Zhang crafted Tumor Tactics, an educational game designed to demystify cancer for young minds. Motivated by his grandmother's battle with the illness, Daniel aims to make intricate cancer biology accessible to children. His project has garnered funding and will be showcased at the United Nations Science Summit, alongside his role in STEAMLabs International, where he promotes STEM and arts education.

title: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max launched: Check India prices, availability
content: Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models.  The iPhone Duo features a large inner display and a smaller outer screen.  iPhone 18 Pro models boast a new 48MP camera and extended battery life.  All devices run on the powerful A20 Pro chip and offer eSIM-only functionality.  Pre-orders and availability dates for India have been announced for these new iPhones.

title: Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump’s wealth: How did they build their fortunes?
content: Vanessa Trump's wealth stems from family investments and real estate holdings. Tiger Woods built a diverse business empire through golf and various ventures. Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Both individuals have significant real estate assets contributing to their financial standing.

title: Caitlin Clark’s $4.5bn brand empire: How is she expanding her influence?
content: Caitlin Clark has expanded her growing off-court profile with a new collection from a major drinkware brand valued at an estimated $4.5 billion. The partnership builds on their collaboration that began in 2025, featuring tumblers and bottles in Clark’s Future design. The Indiana Fever star already boasts major deals with Nike, Gatorade, State Farm and Wilson, highlighting how her influence continues to extend beyond basketball.

title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' to become first $1bn US box office film
content: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is nearing a domestic box-office record.  The film is just ten million dollars away from Star Wars: The Force Awakens.  It has already earned over nine hundred twenty-three million dollars domestically.  Worldwide, the movie has crossed two point four billion dollars.  This performance positions it as a major box-office success.

title: Congress-NC rift over Vande Mataram: The ghost of 1987 and ‘big brother’ complex
content: The alliance between the NC and Congress is witnessing persistent tensions regarding political leadership. Recent arguments over the Vande Mataram reveal significant ideological rifts. Echoes of past events, such as the contentious 1987 election, continue to influence NC's political behavior. The long-term success of this coalition hinges on its ability to balance conflicting priorities as they tackle statehood and Article 370 challenges.

title: US govt proposes scrapping 60-day grace period for foreign workers after job loss
content: The US Department of Homeland Security is considering the elimination of a 60-day grace period for specific visa holders, which could greatly affect Indian H-1B and L-1 visa holders in the United States. This proposal is based on the belief that the grace period compromises the integrity of employment-related visa classifications. A decision to remove this grace period would introduce significant financial and logistical hurdles for those impacted.

title: Shafali stars with 64, Deepti strikes thrice as India storm into 10th Asia Cup final
content: India secured a dominant 40-run victory over Bangladesh to advance into the Women's Asia Cup 2026 final. Shafali Varma's explosive 64-run innings provided a strong foundation for India's competitive total. India's bowlers applied sustained pressure, restricting Bangladesh to 109 runs in their chase. Deepti Sharma was instrumental with the ball, claiming crucial wickets throughout the match. This win extends India's unbeaten streak and sends them to their tenth consecutive final.

title: Smuggled gold Rs 8,000 cheaper per 10g; 100 tonnes may enter India this year
content: The increase in smuggling comes at a time when the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence has intensified its action against organised gold smuggling networks. According to the latest government data released on July 25, the agency seized more than 27 kg of foreign-origin smuggled gold.

title: Akash stares at BSP exit: Why Mayawati decided to 'free' nephew ahead of UP polls

title: Shree Charani creates history at 22, becomes fastest Indian to 50 T20I wickets

title: IRCTC case: Laundering charges framed against Lalu Prasad Yadav, kin
content:
NEW DELHI/PATNA: A Delhi court Thursday framed charges against RJD chief Lalu Prasad, wife Rabri Devi, their son, Tejashwi Prasad Yadav, and six others in a money laundering case linked to the alleged IRCTC hotel scam, report Koushiki Saha & Jai Narain Pandey. The case dates to Lalu's tenure as railway minister in the UPA govt (2004-09). Special judge Vishal Gogne of Rouse Avenue Court observed that tenders for leasing two IRCTC hotels at Ranchi and Puri were manipulated by railway officials under the "stewardship" of Lalu as he framed the charges under PMLA. The others against whom charges were framed included M/s Lara Projects, former RJD Union minister Premchand Gupta and and his wife, Sarla.

End of Article

title: Amid West Asia conflict, Iran president to meet PM Modi today
content: for the first time in eight years, an Iranian president will visit India . Masoud Pezeshkian will participate in the Brics Business Forum meeting . the last Iranian president to visit India was Hassan Rouhani in 2018 .

title: PM receives phone call from German Chancellor Merz, discusses key cooperation areas
content:
NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi late Thursday spoke with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz over the phone on Thursday and discussed ways to further strengthen the India-Germany strategic partnership. The conversation comes as India and Germany mark 75 years of diplomatic relations this year. The two leaders reviewed the progress made in bilateral ties and noted the continued momentum in high-level exchanges between the two countries.PM Modi and Merz reaffirmed their commitment to expanding cooperation in key areas, including trade and investment, advanced technology, clean energy, defence, education and the movement of skilled talent. The leaders also discussed regional and global issues of mutual interest. They agreed to continue working closely to promote peace, stability and prosperity around the world.

title: At least 24 schoolchildren killed after fire engulfs schools in rebel-controlled Congo
content: at least 24 children were killed after a fire swept through the rebel-controlled city of Bukavu in eastern Congo on friday . the dead included 19 girls and five boys, an official says . blaze was extinguished by the afternoon, but white smoke continued to rise from pc .

title: SC asks Centre to reduce cut-off to prevent super-specialty med seats going waste
content: about 1,800 of the more than 4,000 super-specialty medical seats are lying vacant even after two rounds of counselling . the bench of justice pamidighantam Sri Narasimha and justice alok Aradhe said it may be necessary to reconsider the decision for reducing the cut-off percentile .

title: Global climate record: August this year joint-warmest month with July '23
content: this Aug was 1.65° Celsius above the estimated pre-industrial baseline . this was the first month above 1.5° Celsius since Nov 2025 . the period from June to Aug 2026 was the joint-warmest three-month period on record globally .

title: Hasina's daughter quits as WHO regional head after fraud allegations
content: Saima Wazed, daughter of ousted Bangladesh prime minister sheikh hasina, resigned from the post on sept 9 . she was elected regional director by WHO's south-east Asia regional committee in Nov 2023 for a five-year term beginning febr 2024 . the recommendation for her termination was due to be considered by its executive board .

title: Putin lands in Delhi for Brics Summit, to meet PM Modi today
content: the visit comes just days after PM Modi and Putin met on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek on august 31 . the two leaders reviewed cooperation in areas including political ties, trade, defence, space and mobility .

title: Retro looks, current jibes: Netas give '80s a new spin
content: "the 80s called, I answered," quipped agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan . BJP Telangana replied with a fabricated bar scene tagged "Lusiana, Italy" the party accounts joined the nostalgia trip, remembering to pack a few jibes for the other side .

title: Modi-Xi meet: Trade, border on agenda during Xi's 24-hour blitz
content: Xi will be accompanied by a 67-member government delegation . he will arrive at 12.10 pm on Saturday and 12.20 pm departure the next day . the bilateral meeting is likely to take place between the Brics closed session on multilateralism .

title: Houthis seize Yemen's strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed forces
content: the capture brings the Houthis within 75km (46 miles) of the Bab al-Mandab Strait . the group said it posed no threat to international shipping but maintained its threat to target Saudi vessels . residents told the BBC that Houthi fighters entered the city after fierce clashes on Wednesday .

title: DNA main hope for identity, but backlog overwhelms Nepal forensic labs
content: thousands of DNA samples arrive at facilities accustomed to processing fewer than 900 tests in an entire year . the latest count shows 2,678 DNA samples have been collected for identification . forensic laboratory alone has received 1,240 samples for DNA and related examinations .
